blocks.text: Lapu-Lapu City, CEBU — Gabrielle Galapia has given Filipinos another reason for them to continue rallying behind her in her campaign for the Philippines’ sixth Miss Asia Pacific International victory as she dominated the pageant’s recent preliminary competition. The Kapampangan lass bagged both of the major awards of the event held at the Triton Ballroom of JPark Island Resort and Waterpark in Lapu-Lapu City, Cebu, on Tuesday evening, Oct. 6, and walked away as the Best in Swimsuit and Best in Evening Gown.
